lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 fixed the reviewer-flagged wiring gap: `case 'init'` and `case 'setup'` in index.ts (around lines 2510-2537) built the `runSetup({...})` options literal from `setupArgs` but omitted `planApproval`, so `--plan-approval operator` (accepted by `parseSetupArgs`/`ParsedSetupArgs` since US-001) never reached `runSetup` -- `options.planApproval` was always undefined, the interactive prompt fired, read EOF, and defaulted to `'auto'`. Fix: both call sites now include `planApproval: setupArgs.planApproval`. scripts/build-release.sh from US-001 (`--plan-approval operator` in the hermetic smoke) needed NO further change -- it was already passing the flag correctly; the bug was purely in index.ts's forwarding, exactly as the reviewer's notes diagnosed. Added test/init-setup-plan-approval-wiring.test.ts: (1) behavioral coverage of `parseSetupArgs --plan-approval`/`--plan-approval=` parsing (previously untested despite the flag existing since US-001), (2) a textual/static smoke asserting index.ts contains exactly 2 occurrences of `planApproval: setupArgs.planApproval` (one per dispatch call site) -- deliberately NOT an end-to-end spawn of `bun index.ts init ...`, because `runSetup` gates on `verifyAgent()` (real `claude` binary + auth) before ever reaching the plan-approval prompt/print, and CI may not have `claude` installed (build-release.sh's own smoke explicitly tolerates its absence). All quality gates green with zero ratchet adjustments (typecheck, bun test 4620 pass/0 fail, full check:all spine incl. lint/file-size/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps). scripts/cam/prd.json had an unrelated pre-existing working-tree modification (review round 1 findings + US-R1-001 story entry, already present at session start) that this story did NOT touch or commit -- supervisor-owned state.
